transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I guess I'm here because of my eating habits. It's just... at night, when I'm by myself, I'll start eating and then I just... I can't stop. It's like I lose control completely. I'll be sitting there telling myself to just put it away, but I can't.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating at night?
Yeah, um... I guess so. I don't really... I try not to dwell on how I feel afterward. But yeah, it's not a great feeling.
Are you usually eating at night because you're feeling upset or anxious?
I don't know. I guess... maybe? I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... I just eat.
Are you usually hungry when you start eating at night?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess sometimes? But... mostly I don't think I'm actually hungry. I just kind of... start doing it.
Do you think you would eat at night even if you had eaten a full meal earlier in the evening?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I don't really pay attention to whether I had a big dinner or not. So... maybe? I'm just not sure.
Do you usually try to hide or keep secret the fact that you are eating at night?
I mean... I'm usually just by myself anyway. So... I don't know. I haven't really thought about whether it's a secret or not. I'm just alone.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during these nights?

I guess... yeah. Sometimes after my late shifts, I end up eating a lot. Like... I might make a whole frozen pizza. And then just... eat cereal straight out of the box. Or leftovers... just whatever snacks are in the cabinet. It all kind of happens in... I don't know, maybe an hour or two. It's... it's definitely way more than I'd ever eat in front of anyone.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating when you have these episodes at night?

Um... no. Not really. That's... kind of why I'm here. Once I start... it just feels like something else takes over. I can't stop. Even when I'm standing there, telling myself to just put the food away... I just keep going.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes at night?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't noticed. I'm not really... paying attention to how fast it is, I guess.
Do you usually feel anxious or upset right before you start eating at night?
Um... I don't think so. Not really. I'm usually just... coming back from work, so I'm mostly just tired, I guess. I wouldn't say I feel anxious or... upset.
Do you think you eat at night because you're feeling emotional or trying to cope with your feelings?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really... dealing with feelings or anything like that. It's just... something that happens. I don't really know why.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes at night?
Um... didn't you just ask me that? But, yeah, like I said... I don't really know. I'm not timing it or anything. I just eat.
Do you think your eating at night is related to trying to make yourself feel better?

I... no. Like I was just saying, I don't really think it's about feelings or anything. I'm not... I don't feel bad in the first place, so I'm not trying to fix anything or feel better. It's just... I just eat.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during these episodes at night?
Look, you... you literally just asked me that. And like I said... I don't know. I'm not paying attention to how fast I'm going. I just eat.
Do you think you're eating more quickly than you would during a normal meal when you have these episodes at night?

I... I mean, you've asked me this like three times now. I really don't know how to answer it differently. I'm just eating. I don't know if it's faster or slower or whatever. I just... I don't pay attention to that.
Do you think you are eating more quickly during these nighttime episodes than you would during a normal meal?
I... I don't know what else to say. We just went over this. I'm not timing myself. I'm just eating.
Do you think you're eating more quickly than you would during a normal meal when this happens at night?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me this. I really don't. I've told you, I'm not paying attention to the speed. I just... eat. That's it.
Do you think you're eating an amount of food that's more than most people would eat in a similar situation during these episodes at night?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... like, on nights when I get back from a late shift, I'll just... I'll eat a lot. Maybe a whole frozen pizza, and then... I don't know, cereal straight out of the box. Leftovers. Whatever snacks are just sitting in the cabinet. I can go through all of that in like an hour or two. So... yeah, it's definitely way more than I'd ever eat if anyone else was around.
Do you feel like once you start eating at night, you couldn't stop even if you wanted to?

Yeah. Um... I guess that's sort of why I came in. It's... hard to explain. Once I start eating alone like that, it just feels like something takes over. I'll literally be in my head telling myself to put the food away, but... I just can't stop.
